items.b_4: Mr. Wang has a runny nose.
items.c_2: Does your brother have a toothache?
items.c_5: Do Ken and Amy have a cold?
items.d0: This is Lisa. She's from Canada. Lisa is sick today. She has a fever and a runny nose. She doesn't have a cough. Her dad makes some chicken soup for her.
items.d1: It's Moon Festival. My family is having a barbecue in the park. Look! The full moon is big. Grandma gives us some moon cakes. My little brother eats too fast. Now he has a stomachache.
items.j: Hi, I'm Nina. I'm from India. In India, many people drink golden milk when they have a cold. My classmate Tom is from the UK. Today Tom doesn't feel well. He has a sore throat and a headache. He doesn't have a fever. I make some golden milk for him. He likes it. We both like whales. I hope Tom feels better!
